# Fonts

Fraunces, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Literata and Golos Text from Google Fonts
(SIL Open Font License 1.1), downloaded as woff2 files with the CSS Google serves
to current browsers. They are served from this site so visitors' browsers do not
send their IP address to Google (GDPR); the CSP allows fonts and styles only
from 'self'.

- `fonts.css` – Fraunces and Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (all pages and the admin).
- `fonts-uk.css` – Literata and Golos Text, the Cyrillic fallback for Ukrainian.
